title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - LegitimateInterest
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/LegitimateInterest. A legitimate interest entity describing reasons for processing personal identifiable information (PII).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'LegitimateInterest'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

legalBasis.description: Property. Reasons to process PII as detailed in the applicable personal data protection regime.

dataProtectionContact.description: Property. A URL pointing to a contact form or an email address.
